sharedContext: WAVE-500 receipt-conformance sweep (batch dispatch 25-worker example). Goal: verify that recent lane receipts conform to the v1 receipt contract {workerId, status, summary<=280 chars, filesChanged[], testsRun, openQuestions[]} so the coordinator can trust batch fan-in instead of re-parsing free text. Sampling frame: the 10 most recent receipts per lane as found on the live work-claims board (uuriko/project-room#266, REST numeric comment ids, paginate oldest-first) plus the lane's wave ledger under ~/workspace where one exists. Conformance checks per receipt: (1) all six v1 fields present; (2) summary <= 280 chars; (3) status in {done, error, timeout, cancelled}; (4) filesChanged entries are real repo paths at the receipt's claimed SHA; (5) testsRun names an actual command with a pass/fail count. Conventions: read-only — never edit another lane's receipt; write your findings to docs/measurements/receipt-conformance/<workerId>.md as a 10-row pass/fail table quoting offending fields verbatim. First-claim-wins: confirm no sibling owns your lane slice before starting. Your own completion uses the same v1 receipt contract. One worker failing never blocks the others; the coordinator aggregates per-worker status.
